sketches.mechanism: Move semantics: passing a non-Copy value by value transfers ownership, so the second use is rejected at compile time.
sketches.resonance: What has truly been given is no longer yours to offer again.

sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation: a self-referential bottom value may exist unevaluated when placed where the program never demands it.
sketches.resonance: An endless fall can remain harmless while no one asks it to arrive.

sketches.mechanism: Temporal dead zone: a let binding exists in scope during its initializer but cannot be read until initialization completes.
sketches.resonance: A self cannot be made by reaching back to itself before it has begun.
